name: Auto PR pending-review to main

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - pending-review

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  open-pr:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Check for existing open PR
        id: check_pr
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=$(gh pr list \
            --base main \
            --head pending-review \
            --state open \
            --json number \
            --jq '.[0].number')
          echo "pr_number=$PR_NUMBER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Create pull request
        if: steps.check_pr.outputs.pr_number == ''
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          gh pr create \
            --base main \
            --head pending-review \
            --title "Promote update sets: pending-review to main" \
            --body "Auto-generated pull request to promote committed update sets from \`pending-review\` into \`main\`. Please review Copilot's comments before merging." \
            --label "update-set"

      - name: Skip if PR already exists
        if: steps.check_pr.outputs.pr_number != ''
        run: echo "An open PR (#${{ steps.check_pr.outputs.pr_number }}) already exists from pending-review to main. Skipping creation."
